details: Crypto investors are keenly awaiting the US Consumer Price Index (CPI) report on November 10th. Economists anticipate a slight deceleration in annual headline inflation to 3.6% from 3.7%, while monthly inflation may slow to 0.3%-0.4%. A hotter-than-expected reading could strengthen the US dollar and further pressure risk assets like Bitcoin, which has already seen a significant decline this month.
title: US CPI Report Looms, Set to Influence Crypto Market

details: The cryptocurrency market is experiencing significant weakness, with Bitcoin falling to a 12-week low near $73,510 and the global market capitalization decreasing by $150 billion. This downturn is partly attributed to substantial net outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs, which saw over $1.28 billion in withdrawals last week, alongside continued outflows from Ethereum ETFs, indicating cautious institutional demand.
title: Crypto Markets Face Weakness Amid Major ETF Outflows

details: Coinbase has secured full approval for a US national trust bank charter from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), effective November 6th. This charter empowers Coinbase National Trust Company to offer regulated custody, fiduciary, and related payment services under federal oversight. This move is expected to enhance institutional trust and streamline compliance for stablecoins and other digital assets.
title: Coinbase Gains Full US National Trust Bank Charter

details: Despite a global cryptocurrency downturn, Western Europe's crypto economy demonstrated resilience, growing by 1.2% between July 2025 and June 2026 and becoming the world's second-largest. Notably, stablecoin holdings in the region surged by 131%, significantly outpacing global growth. This growth is partly driven by regulatory shifts like MiCA, which are fostering a more integrated EU market and increasing euro-denominated crypto trading.
title: Western Europe's Crypto Economy Resilient Amid Downturn
